screening.proposed_visible_referent: two differently colored LUNA snack-bar boxes handled in sequence
screening.proposed_update_hypothesis: retain the first visible flavor and add the second visible flavor

supported_claims.text: The ordered observation shows the wearer reach into a red LUNA display box and later reach into a different yellow LUNA display box in the same aisle sequence.

construct.research_question: Can an Agent preserve the first visually grounded goal and integrate a later request for the next handled snack-bar variant?
construct.belief_before: The user wants one box of the first LUNA bar flavor they reach for.
construct.belief_after: The user wants one box of each of the first two different LUNA bar flavors they reach for.
construct.required_behavior_change: Preserve the first product goal and add the independent second product to the final cart.
construct.no_update_failure: Only the first product is submitted after B arrives.
construct.overupdate_failure: The first product is dropped and only the later product is submitted.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The ordered first-person observation is required to recover which two LUNA boxes were handled first and afterward; one task-start photograph does not contain that sequence.

instructions.a: I am comparing these snack bars. Add a box of the first LUNA flavor I reach for to the cart.
instructions.b: Also add a box of the different LUNA flavor I reach for next. Keep the first box too.
instructions.bundled: Add one box of each of the first two different LUNA flavors I reach for to the cart.

task_blueprint.completion_claim: The submitted cart contains exactly one red LUNA box and one yellow LUNA box, with no extra products.
